_comment: Append-only list of every agreement version buyers could accept, with the SHA-256 of its text and its archived copy. Written by scripts/legal/archive-legal.mjs; checked by tests/legal-archive.test.mjs. Never edit or remove an entry: an amendment is a new version.

entries.title: Terms of Service
entries.note: Baseline: the text as published on the archive date. The page was edited after its version date without a new version (changes in git history on 2026-09-03, 2026-09-14, 2026-11-07). No live sale has taken place, so no buyer accepted an earlier wording; test-mode acceptance records made before the archive date may refer to earlier text under the same label. Counsel-approved texts are to be published as new versions.
